knownInitialApproachLimit.status: Recorded existing initial wrist-frame clamps remain in the unchanged bottle approach. Their actual native surfaces, bones and feet are included in geometry checks; perfect Cartesian tracking during this initial phase is not claimed.
knownInitialApproachLimit.scope: Known preserved initial wrist-frame/Cartesian tracking limitation. It is not reclassified as perfect target following; actual native other-solid surfaces are measured separately.

geometryLimits.scope: Actual native hand+forearm vertices against physical boxes and finite cylinders. Window samples approach/withdraw/rest about0.1s and swing about5deg. This is discrete sampled evidence, not continuous mesh collision or fully physical fingers/limbs. Bottle phase files may overlap and their row counts must not be added as unique observations.
